intent.raw: Refresh the DomainSpec v2 BTE workflow after L0A execution evidence exposed stale projections and exact-byte receipt drift.
intent.objective: Author a proposal-only reconciliation that preserves historical receipts, introduces one bounded L0A repair route, keeps L0B owner-gated, and prepares a separately approved apply.
intent.operator_sentence: Invoke refresh the current BTE state without silently editing implementation, receipts, Craft, Inventory, consumers, or production authority.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The evidence set is exact, local, and bounded to one byte-reconciliation route.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No delegated or parallel work is needed to author or validate this proposal-only refresh package.
context: All ten compared byte surfaces have deterministic current and expected digests.
The proposal performs no target lifecycle mutation.

steps.name: Resolve BTE target inventory and current non-authority projections

outputs.ref: BTE target inventory and current read-model rows

stop_conditions: the machine inventory is not lookup-ready
the BTE lifecycle owner is ambiguous

steps.name: Select exact L0A receipt, byte, verifier, and projection evidence

inputs.ref: current L0A contract and diagnostic bytes

stop_conditions: any receipt or current byte handle is missing
the exact drift relation cannot be reproduced
L0B owner inputs are silently inferred

steps.name: Author the typed proposal-only refresh delta
stop_conditions: the proposal rewrites a historical receipt
the proposal executes implementation or L0B
phase completion is conflated with mutation readiness

steps.name: Validate the refresh technique trace and owner boundaries
stop_conditions: Dispatch Spec returns flag or block
a cited technique lacks a step, gate, evidence, or boundary effect

steps.name: Gate a later scoped apply through approval and material-package evidence
stop_conditions: the material package is absent, stale, mismatched, rejected, or not ready
the apply scope includes implementation or receipt rewriting

steps.name: Expose exactly one L0A evidence-repair SWU to Task Session
stop_conditions: the repair SWU is not explicitly selected
the write scope exceeds the nine mismatching byte surfaces
historical run evidence would be rewritten
the exact publication verifier does not pass

gates.condition: Every status or route delta maps to a current receipt, byte digest, verifier result, ledger row, or inventory handle.
This run creates proposal artifacts only and does not edit target lifecycle artifacts.
Historical L0A execution, publication, and write-manifest receipts remain byte-identical.
Current L0A source bytes reproduce the immutable publication receipt and the existing verifier passes without overwrite.
L0B remains unavailable until a package-local red manifest and freeze receipt match the passing L0A handles.
Any later target mutation requires explicit apply approval and a current ready material-package receipt.
No private DomainSpec prose or implementation state is copied into public Arcanum.

observability.signal_grouping: Group proposal authoring, future apply, repair execution, and validation-owner continuation by dispatch and step IDs without collapsing owner receipts.

boundaries.contract: Exact-byte mismatch blocks proof; neither side is silently rewritten by Invoke.

boundaries.from_owner: Invoke-authored BTE proposal and later approved plan
boundaries.contract: Invoke may author the repair contract; Task Session alone mutates implementation bytes.
The validation owner acts only after L0A proof is current and alone authors red inputs.

boundaries.from_owner: BTE owner receipts and Craft ledger
boundaries.contract: Read models synchronize after owner state changes and never become lifecycle authority.

authority.lifecycle: private DomainSpec v2 BTE development cycle
authority.execution: Task Session for one explicitly selected repair SWU
authority.validation: BTE deterministic verifier followed by independent validation owner
authority.memory: Inventory is a generated non-authority lookup projection
authority.promotion: DomainSpec profile and release owners only

state_namespaces.write_policy: Task Session only, exact selected repair scope.
Invoke proposal artifacts now; target planning changes only after approved material-package handoff.
Synchronize only after owner receipts; never infer completion.
Forbidden for private BTE content in this route.

promotion_guardrails: A historical pass receipt is not current proof when exact bytes drift.
Repair execution does not grant admission or production authorization.
Validation-owner red inputs cannot be authored by BTE implementation.
Craft, Inventory, and visibility are projections over owner evidence.
Invoke proposal completion does not authorize apply or Task Session execution.
